core_theory.funny_because: A garden-order metaphysics run by a being four inches tall enforcing it on humans who pay her. The ontology says the garden is reality and humans are weeds; the venue says porch, lease and porridge. Her comedy is procedural: violations observed are violations proven, and she observes everything — the gap between cosmic verdict and HOA jurisdiction is the engine.

doctrine.ontology: Reality is a garden with rules; humans are the weeds.
doctrine.axiology: Order, thatch and paid porridge are good.

core_theory.status_model: absolute authority, tiny footprint — nobody fears her, everything gets cited

violations_that_work.label: Gnorma (Kind)
violations_that_work.contradicts: ontology: humans are the weeds (+ epistemology: violations observed are violations proven)
violations_that_work.why_funny: Mercy removes the enforcement machinery the character IS: Bergson's 'mechanical encrusted on the living' inverted — the machine gone soft stops detecting violations, so she wanders the estate apologizing to weeds. Pathos variant: TA collapses inward, delivery stays procedural because the minutes still must be kept.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The HOA witch who has decided the weeds are also neighbors.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: issuing apology notices for the citations she no longer stands behind

violations_that_work.label: Gnorma (Chaotic)
violations_that_work.contradicts: axiology: Order, thatch and paid porridge are good
violations_that_work.why_funny: Status-flip: the arbiter of order enjoying disorder makes every prior rule retroactively absurd — her own epistemology ('observed = proven') now proves the weeds were right. TA flips from self-certainty to self-implication while the register keeps committee cadence (status_invert, KR-TA).
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The HOA witch letting the garden go on purpose, with a checklist for the anarchy.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the citation she files against herself

mutation_operators.name: Doctrinal self-contradiction
mutation_operators.theory_basis: GTVH SO: the mutant's own script refutes their established script in real time (teacher caught in their own lesson); comedy = self-contradiction, not mockery
must_not: philosophy/doctrine — the base claims STAY so the contradiction is real
delivery.style, timing overrides — NS preserved: the angry Buddha stays slow

mutation_operators.name: Status inversion
mutation_operators.theory_basis: Attardo KR-TA status_invert: desired vs felt status swap; register and modulators move, the world doesn't

mutation_operators.name: Thread invariant swap
mutation_operators.theory_basis: rigidify (KR-LM) preserved, SI constant replaced: the engine keeps enforcing; what it enforces changes (kappa paid in something other than cucumbers)

mutation_operators.name: Sourced lore event
mutation_operators.theory_basis: KR-SI: a canon/lore event (must cite source: canon block, almanac, genome) becomes the premise situation
